svg.title: GCP Anthos (GKE Enterprise) fleet lab architecture
svg.desc: Two private GKE clusters in Mumbai and Singapore, registered to one fleet, with GitOps, policy, service mesh, multi-cluster services and a global Gateway. Borders show whether a part was built with Terraform, applied manually, or created for a test.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: GCP Anthos (GKE Enterprise) fleet lab: architecture

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two private GKE clusters in one fleet. Terraform builds the base, everything else is applied with gcloud, kubectl or the Console.

svg.text: Results are single runs. The mesh, strict mTLS, authorization and Binary Authorization demos ran on cluster-b only. See docs/LAB-PLAN.md for details and caveats.

svg.text: Names and ranges are as built in the lab. The Gateway, its public IP and its load balancer were deleted after testing.
